en.title: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification Guarantees for Neural Operators
en.hook: Establishing rigorous uncertainty guarantees for fast neural operators approximating function spaces.
key_takeaways: Addresses the lack of uncertainty quantification in neural operator predictions
Develops a split conformal framework to provide rigorous error bounds
Enhances prediction reliability in complex function space approximations

key_takeaways: 解决快速代理模型——神经算子缺乏不确定性量化的痛点
开发分割保角预测框架（Split conformal framework），提供严格的误差保证
显著提升复杂函数空间近似预测的可靠性
